Reference image for the [[Jokes]] row on [[Dr. Evazan & •Ponda Baba]]: Dr. Evazan (Alfie Curtis) face to face with Luke Skywalker in the Mos Eisley cantina in ''Star Wars'' (1977), as he tells Luke "I don't like you either." Luke is in the foreground, seen from behind. Brightened slightly so the faces can be seen; otherwise unaltered, 640 by 360 pixels.

Source: a frame at 1:49 of [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=sPelOnd7Sik Star Wars: A New Hope - Luke Skywalker Enters the Cantina &#91;CLIP&#93; | TNT], TNT, YouTube (3 November 2020), a clip of the film ''Star Wars'' (1977), written and directed by George Lucas, Lucasfilm and 20th Century Fox. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261027142723/https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=sPelOnd7Sik Internet Archive], 27 October 2026.

License: Non-free. Fair-use rationale: one low-resolution frame from the film, showing the moment whose line the card's lore repeats. It is used only to identify that work beside the card on [[Jokes]]. It cannot replace the original or harm its market, and no free image of it exists.
